name: Dr Sujit Prakash Gujar
description: Dr. Sujit Gujar is an Associate Professor and CA Technologies Faculty Chair at IIIT Hyderabad, leading the Machine Learning Lab. His research develops game-theoretic foundations for modern AI and distributed AI/blockchains, ensuring fairness in these systems, spanning 125+ peer-reviewed publications and 15+ US patents. He earned his Ph.D. from the Indian Institute of Science, Bangalore, winning the IISc Alumni Medal for best CSA thesis, and previously researched at EPFL and Xerox Research.
